name: assignment-grant-check-is-prose-only
body: The assignment grant-coverage rule is prose in three shipped prompt templates (plan-review's Assignment criterion, the plan-writer's assignment rule, the implementation-phase reviewer's assignment bullet); the binary validator checks only roster membership, so a task whose assigned Agent's declared permissions exclude an operation-edge target path is caught by review reading the Agent definition, never by `apg plan verify`. Upgrade to an automated verify-gate check, comparing each operation-edge target against the assigned Agent's declared permission globs, if an assignment-grant mismatch recurs.
